tools.name: list_pages
tools.title: List website pages
tools.description: List every public page on the Patel Impex website with its route and title. Use this to discover what content is available before calling get_page.

tools.name: search_pages
tools.title: Search website pages
tools.description: Find Patel Impex website pages whose route or title matches a keyword. Returns matching routes to read with get_page.

tools.name: get_page
tools.title: Read a website page
tools.description: Fetch the readable text content of one public Patel Impex website page. Pass a route from list_pages, for example '/services' or '/'.

route.description: Page route from list_pages, e.g. '/about'. Use '/' for the home page.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.title: Get company & contact info
tools.description: Get Patel Impex's published company details: business summary, email, phone number and office locations.
